doc: Cloud fraction with a float32 latitude array: the shift and the ITCZ gaussian are float64 (the code converts), the smoothsteps stay float32 and the sum is float64. Shifts 0 and 8 degrees (inputs). Tolerance rtol 1e-5, atol 1e-6 (the default): measured against the float64-promoted computation (max abs 5.6e-8) and a one-ulp nudge of the latitudes (max abs 1.8e-7, 0.03 of the default band).

params.dtype_chain: lat float32: x = |lat| / hadley is float32 and feeds the two smoothsteps (float32); lat is converted by np.asarray(float64), so the shift fade, x_itcz and the ITCZ gaussian are float64 and the final sum (0.20 + float64 + float32 + float32) is float64: the output is float64.
